fragilityClusters.area: Dynamic protocol-destination screening across time (Raffle._isProtocolDestination at Raffle.sol:L593-L605 and RaffleFactory.isRaffle at RaffleFactory.sol:L54, L125)
fragilityClusters.why: _isProtocolDestination is evaluated at clone initialization (Raffle.sol:L187-L195), ticket mint/transfer (Raffle._update at L498), and USDC payouts (Raffle._transferQuote at L565), but not on ERC-721 prize transfers (L334, L404). Because it skips isRaffle when destination.code.length == 0 (L602) while RaffleFactory.isRaffle grows monotonically as CREATE clones are deployed (RaffleFactory.sol:L106, L125), a precomputed future clone address transitions from _isProtocolDestination == false before deployment to true after deployment.

fragilityClusters.area: Untrusted prizeToken callbacks during atomic creation and terminal delivery (RaffleFactory.sol:L128-L134, Raffle.sol:L334-L337, L404-L405, L416-L431)
fragilityClusters.why: params.prizeToken is an arbitrary sponsor-supplied contract screened only for bytecode presence (RaffleFactory.sol:L155) and ERC-165 IERC721 support (L172). During createRaffle, safeTransferFrom (L128) invokes untrusted prizeToken code after clone initialization and registration; once onERC721Received sets status = Status.Active (Raffle.sol:L428), external calls into the active clone (such as buyEntries) can execute before RaffleCreated is emitted (RaffleFactory.sol:L136), and terminal prize delivery in redeemWinningTicket (Raffle.sol:L334-L337) and releaseSponsorPrize (L404-L405) depends on prizeToken.transferFrom and prizeToken.ownerOf behavior. Additionally, Raffle inherits ERC721 without overriding supportsInterface to report IERC721Receiver (ERC721.sol:L45-L50).

fragilityClusters.area: VRF draw request in-flight guard, dual fee quoting, and deadline partitioning (Raffle.sol:L240-L273, L276-L301, L458-L465, L509-L524)
fragilityClusters.why: requestDraw queries i_vrfV2PlusWrapper twice (L249 and L257, checking msg.value at L250 and L258), uses _requestInFlight (L254, L260, L511) to prevent a synchronous rawFulfillRandomWords callback from resolving before vrfRequestId is stored (L259), and refunds excess native ETH via assembly call (L266-L269) after clearing _requestInFlight. Resolution in fulfillRandomWords (L512) and refund activation in enableRefunds (L289-L291) partition time around callbackDeadline() (L463-L465), which relies on drawRequestedAt = uint64(block.timestamp) (L253) being non-zero whenever status == Status.Drawing.

fragilityClusters.area: Split creation validation between RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams and Raffle.initialize (RaffleFactory.sol:L98-L125, L154-L179; Raffle.sol:L176-L206)
fragilityClusters.why: Validation of raffle configuration is divided across two contracts and before/after clone deployment: _validateCreateParams checks prizeToken code, ERC-165 IERC721 support, reserveEntries > 0, and pre-clone sink checks, while createRaffle checks endTime bounds; Raffle.initialize omits those checks but is the sole place screening msg.sender (sponsor), protocolTreasury vs. prizeToken, and sponsor/protocolTreasury/sponsorRecipient against the newly deployed clone address (destination == address(this) at Raffle.sol:L599) before isRaffle[raffle] is set at RaffleFactory.sol:L125.

fragilityClusters.area: Decoupled settlement vs. redemption and un-guarded ERC-721 ticket transfers (Raffle.sol:L235, L304-L346, L497-L502, L533-L558; ERC721.sol:L93-L136)
fragilityClusters.why: _settleWinningTicket allocates protocolFees, sponsorProceeds, and winnerProceeds in storage without reading ticket ownership or performing external calls, whereas redeemWinningTicket, refundTickets, releaseSponsorProceeds, releaseProtocolFees, and releaseSponsorPrize perform independent pull-based transfers. Meanwhile, inherited ERC-721 transfer and approval functions do not carry nonReentrant and remain callable across all statuses and during external callbacks (_safeMint in buyEntries at L235, native refund in requestDraw at L267).

trustBoundaries.reaches: Checks sponsor authority or endTime when status == Status.Active and totalEntries == 0 (L280-L284), drawRequestDeadline() when status == Status.Active and totalEntries != 0 (L285-L288), or callbackDeadline() when status == Status.Drawing (L289-L291), zeroes unsettledPot, writes remainingRefundLiability, and sets status = Status.Refunding (L296-L299).
